text:
ellen: Quick sync I opened a docs PR to consolidate v1->v2 guidance and a small set of example apps. Link: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/860. Need reviewers for the example apps and the deprecation microcopy.

raj: I can review the Python examples. Will check the embed reindexing note; want a runnable script we can point to.

tom: I'll take TS snippets + streaming. Noticed some older examples rely on `EventSource` streaming behavior. v2 uses async iterators in SDKs. I'll add side-by-side comparisons.

yara: I can draft the customer-facing two-line banner and a short FAQ section. Can we agree on the shutdown dates?

elllen: (typo) sorry, meant liz: Proposed dates in the PR description: announcement 2026-05-01, 90-day migration, shutdown 2026-09-01. Marketing asked for a concise "what to do" checklist.

yara: Draft FAQ Q: "Will my embeddings stop working?" A: "If you pinned a model alias that changes dims, you should reindex. See appendix B." OK?

raj: For the reindex appendix I'll add a small batch script pseudo-code and CLI examples for common vector stores (pinecone/faiss). Example: `python reindex.py --src-model old-emb --dst-model new-emb --batch 500`.

liz: Please include an estimated compute cost comment for reindexing (per 100k items), so customers can plan.

raj: Adding a back-of-envelope: ~ $12 per 100k items on dedicated for 1536-dim conversion (very rough). Will mark as estimate.

ci-bot: Please add a `docs-smoke` job to run examples.

tom: Adding GH Actions job that spins up a v2 shim in docker-compose and runs the examples. I'll add a simple `--skip-network` flag for offline runs.

ellen: Ownership: tom (ts-snippets, streaming), raj (py-snippets, reindex script), yara (customer copy + FAQ), liz (merge + final signoff).

yara: Marketing wants the exact one-liner: how about: "Redwood v1 API is retiring on Sep 1, 2026; migrate to v2 by Aug 1 to avoid interruption." Too blunt?

liz: Nice and clear. Maybe soften: "We plan to retire the v1 API on Sep 1, 2026. To avoid interruption, please migrate to v2 by Aug 1, 2026."

yara: Perfect. I'll put that in the banner and add a click-through to the migration guide.

tom: Small docs note: streaming framing. Old examples assumed newline-delimited JSON fragments. v2 streaming may emit `framing: json` chunks that must be assembled. I'll add a helper util snippet `assembleChunks(chunks)` for TS and `join_stream_chunks()` for py.

raj: Also flagging an SDK behavior change: `client.generate()` now returns a `Response` with `meta` and `items` fields instead of raw array. Will add migration mapping table: old field -> new path.

ellen: Can we add a short compatibility table at the top: SDK status (py/ts/ruby), alias support, embed dim changes, streaming diff? Keep it one page.

liz: Yes. Make it scannable: green/yellow/red and an action column.

docs-bot: New PR checklist missing: add `owner:` labels and `smoke-test:required`.

tom: Added `owner:tom` to TS files and `owner:raj` to py files. Also bumped example deps: node 20 -> 20.4 and undici.

yara: For external comms: can we also offer a migration clinic (office hours) in May? Marketing will schedule if we say yes.

liz: Let's do one live Q&A + weekly office hours for 6 weeks post-announcement. Add link to sign-up in the guide.

raj: Question: should we auto-create model aliases in the platform for common mappings? I think yes but document that aliases are ephemeral.

liz: Agreed. We'll create aliases for the top 10 customer-used models and document the mapping. Also recommend pinning exact model versions for production.

ellen: Last thing: can we add a changelog entry `docs/changes/2026-04-03-v1-sunset.md` that lists the major user-facing changes?

docs-bot: Changelog requirement added to PR.

tom: I'll add the iterator-based streaming examples now and push. Expecting CI to run shortly.

ci-bot: docs-smoke job started for branch docs/migration-860.

liz: Thanks everyone. If CI green, merge after 48h review window unless critical comments show up. :ship:
